value.answer: This needs emergency care now - go to the ER. Fever with purple spots that don't fade when pressed must be checked right away, even if your child seems fairly well.
value.triage: Go to the ER now. Call 911 if you can't get there fast, or if your child is drowsy, floppy, breathing fast, has a stiff neck, or the spots are spreading. Don't wait for 811 nurse advice - this is a 911 and ER situation.
sources: NHS and UK pediatric emergency guidance on fever with non-blanching rash
Sheffield Children's NHS petechial rash guideline
